compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is from an app related to rhythm input, likely for music practice or education. The screen is divided into two main tabs: "STANDARD" and "CUSTOM." The "STANDARD" tab is currently selected.

The main contents of the screen include a list of rhythm exercises, each with a title and a description of the rhythm pattern (e.g., "Quarters and eights," "Half, quarter and eight," etc.). Each exercise also indicates the number of bars (e.g., "1 bar," "2 bars") and the number of tasks associated with it (e.g., "10 tasks").

One of the exercises, "Half, quarter and eight with dots," is locked and has an "upgrade" button next to it, suggesting that it requires a premium version or additional purchase to access.

At the bottom of the screen, there is a prominent "Get Premium!" button, likely encouraging users to upgrade to a premium version of the app for additional features or content.
